preview: This episode looks at a diary app and a familiar problem: sometimes it is hard to know what to write. We’ll explore what this new approach might change about keeping a diary.
comment_1: Listen for what the person tells the app and what the pet does next.
comment_2: You tell the pet what happened, and it writes the diary. What might it do with an ordinary day?
comment_3: So far, you tell your pet about your day, and the pet turns it into a diary. Next, listen for how having the pet tell the story may change the way the diary feels.
comment_4: Some days are hard to write about when we have to tell the story ourselves. Here, a pet tells the diary, making us curious about how the day will appear on the page. Now let’s bring the main idea together.
